customer.sla.title: Customer SLA
customer.sla.text: Free text for the service levels agreed with this customer (response or resolution times, reporting duties). It is shown on the customer's pages for reference only: IRIS-NG does not measure or enforce it.

customer.sectors.title: Customer sectors
customer.sectors.text: The critical-infrastructure sectors this customer works in, from the sector catalog (Manage -> Case objects -> Sectors; enabled sectors only). A case created for this customer from Create case or the API that has no sector tag of its own gets these sectors as tags; a case opened by escalating an alert does not. Changing the list later retags no existing case. Sector tags feed the dashboard's sector metrics.

customer.contacts.title: Customer contacts
customer.contacts.text: People to reach at this customer: name, role, e-mail, phones and a note. They are kept for reference; IRIS-NG never e-mails or notifies them. A customer with contacts cannot be deleted until its contacts are removed.

customer.delete.title: Deleting a customer
customer.delete.text: Possible only when no case, alert, alert cluster, mail rule or contact refers to the customer; otherwise IRIS-NG refuses. The customer's user associations and its entries in the customer asset registry are deleted with it.
